cases.ask: Paint only the hood matte blue.
For my next track day, please paint only the hood matte blue. Leave every other panel exactly as it is because I already like the current body color and do not want the rest changed.
Make the roof pearl gold with fine hex cells only there.

advisorAnswer.text:
A layered look: 3 layers in one zone on the roof:
- **Base**: CF: Champagne Frost [brightness -24] — Pale champagne gold and cream pearl flake, bright and soft like frosted celebration paint. (high gloss, high metal); brightness -24 toward gold
- **Pattern**: Hex Mesh — paint pattern on top: Dense fine honeycomb mesh with bright glowing cell edges, high contrast, tightly packed… — x0.42 size, 65% strength; pairs with matte black, gunmetal
- **Shine**: Pearl Micro — shine texture (colours stay): Smooth undulating mother-of-pearl iridescence, soft micro sparkle, no anisotropy; gentle… — x1 size, 70% strength; pairs with gloss, metallic
Size: Hex Mesh at "fine" = x0.42 (0.6 of its normal x0.7).
2 alternative stacks below. **Use this kit** puts every layer on the roof in one step (one Undo); nothing changes until you press it.

cases.ask: Set the whole car to silver.
For a clean new look before the weekend, set the whole car to silver. Please apply the same silver base across every painted body panel and do not add any stripes or patterns.

advisorAnswer.text:
Here are 3 finish kits for your whole car (body + stripes). In each kit the accents have a different shine from the body, the numbers stay plain, and no finish is used twice across the kits. A texture only changes the shine pattern: your colours stay. **Use this kit** applies the whole kit in one step (one Undo).
- **Classic**: Body Wet Look, Stripes Satin. Proven finishes: calm, clean and easy to read.
- **Premium**: Body Pearl, Stripes Brushed, Texture (hood) Carbon 2×2 Twill. Richer materials: pearl, metal and candy depth, still tasteful, plus a fine shine texture on the hood.
- **Bold**: Body Metallic, Stripes Anodized, Hood (hero) Chameleon Fire, Texture (roof) Liquid Metal. A statement: stronger finishes, a complete-look hero panel on the hood and a texture on the roof.
